title: Test wp11_token_db_lookup_unknown() coverage gap
description: wp11_token_db_lookup_unknown() is declared public API (wolfp11/wp11_token_db.h:90-94) and implemented (src/wp11_token_db.c:140-143) but has zero test coverage. No test in wp11_test_token_db.c ever calls it. The function returns a statically-allocated fallback descriptor with proto=WP11_PROTO_PIV, quirks=WP11_QUIRK_SHORT_APDU, algos=RSA2048|EC_P256, name='Generic PIV Token'. Tests needed: non-NULL return, stable pointer identity, correct proto/quirks/algos/name fields.
